# Visual Showcase Assets

This directory contains real hardware media, installation photos, and preview assets for **D1 Pellet Level Monitor**.

## Hardware Gallery

* **`banner.png`**: Social preview banner ($1280 \times 640$) featuring project highlights and real hardware photos.
* **`d1_pellet_components.jpg`**: Compact electronics before assembly — Wemos D1 Mini (USB-C ESP8266), `CJVL53L0XV2` Time-of-Flight laser ranging breakout, and mini breadboard next to a standard desktop mouse for scale.
* **`d1_pellet_hopper_mount.jpg`**: Dust-resistant IP55 junction box housing both the Wemos D1 Mini and VL53L0X (with a bottom laser aperture), secured with zip-ties directly onto the pellet hopper metal safety grid, complete with a service cable loop for lid opening.
* **`d1_pellet_closed_lid.jpg`**: Clean exterior view of the hydro-pellet stove ($4.8\text{ kW}$ room / $18.5\text{ kW}$ water) with the hopper lid closed and the USB power cable routed cleanly through the recessed handle slot without pinching the perimeter gasket.
